_doc: The dated event registry (G12, 2026-10-13). THE one place to add a Google update or a data break: build_v4.py inlines it into v5/code/_annotations.js and v5/code/_site_stats.js and writes app/shared/src/seo-events.generated.ts for the app's charts. Add an entry, rebuild, done. SOURCE (B6-4, re-read 2026-10-15): Google's Search Status Dashboard ranking history, https://status.search.google.com/products/rGHU1u87FJnkP6W2GwMi/history — the only first-party list. It publishes each update's START and its DURATION, so the `end` below is the start plus that duration and is derived, not quoted. Copy the name Google uses: a 'core update' and a 'spam update' are different systems, and naming one as the other tells a customer their fall came from something that never ran. Nothing goes in here that is not on that page.

data_breaks.name: num=100 stopped working
data_breaks.detail: Google stopped serving 100 results on one page in mid-September 2025, so the SEO tools that read 100 results at a time disappeared from the counts. Impressions fell and average position improved on most sites without anything changing on the site: figures from before and after this break are not comparable.
